context: Ongoing: Vent path sizing and cell spacing to contain a single-cell runaway. This week: Rev B: larger vent channel, mica sheets, spacing stays 2 mm.
Ongoing: FOC rewrite with a thermal model and derating for DVT actuators
Ongoing: Aluminum links gall on 303 pins under side load. This week: Amara wants bronze bushings; Kenji says no room, wall would be 0.6 mm.
Ongoing: Backlash in the rev B cycloidal reducer and whether to shim or re-grind. This week: Shim vs re-grind debate; Arjun leans shim for DVT, re-grind the disc profile for PVT.
Ongoing: Running the knee at 40 C ambient for DVT; chamber access and feedthrough. This week: Andre needs a shaft feedthrough plate machined to run the knee inside the chamber.
Ongoing: Harness conductors breaking at the knee after ~15k flex cycles
Ongoing: Integrated DVT plan across actuators and legs and which dates are real. This week: Beth publishes the DVT plan: actuator build 9/29, gate 10/13, leg build 10/27.
Ongoing: Spend running ahead of plan; push to stop default expedites
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting
